summary: nav is exactly six surfaces in contract order: install · docs · tools · languages · editors · support
footer links every live surface; shared footer renders on every live surface
retired paths redirect through one declaration: /faq, /contact, /troubleshooting, /demos
built sitemap.xml lists 59 indexable routes and no retired path
docs carries every remediation command; the retired troubleshooting page carries none
/demos has no film markup and its media is absent from the published bundle
limitations: Rendered-HTML link scanning covers the surfaces that can link a retired path (support, nav, footer, docs, install); a retired link inside a long-form legal page would not be seen here.
